wa_left_gull.notes: SAFETY: Mountain Project says the original start runs through very large detached flakes and is not recommended; the usual start is the first 20 ft of Spring Fever (wa_spring_fever_3), stepping right at the first ledge. It also says 2016 rockfall wiped out the old continuation across the ledges to Right Gull. The row stores no overview or description, so no stored prose sends climbers onto the flakes, but the generic hazards line does not warn of them either. SEAGULL: Left Gull's own page puts its anchor (2016 webbing with rap rings round the pillar top, one Metolius rap bolt and a piton) atop the 80 ft pillar and says Seagull and Ten-A-Cee Stemming share it. Seagull's own MP page says 2 pitches / 200 ft, but its description reads as one pitch topping out on jugs. This does NOT settle Seagull: the one publisher contradicts itself (80 ft shared anchor vs 200 ft / 2 pitches), and theCrag gives Seagull no length or count. Keep Seagull's pitches and length held. Left Gull is not on theCrag. No house-spelling anchor fits (webbing + bolt + piton), so no anchor proposed.
